source_summary: Chinese garden/landscape scene with a large foreground tree, a low open pavilion containing a reclining scholar, cultivated field bands, marsh reeds, winding water, lotus leaves, rocks, and grasses. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: foreground_leafy_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground tree rising in front of the pavilion: twisting trunk and exposed roots, forked branches, and clustered fine leaves extending across the middle of the scene. Mask out the pavilion, fence, field bands, seals, and background washes except where the tree linework visibly overlaps them.
must_preserve: gnarled double trunk with dark contour lines
exposed root forms at the base
forking branch structure visible through foliage
dense clusters of short needle-like leaf strokes
pale ink wash and darker accent strokes on bark

motifs.name: open_pavilion_with_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the low open pavilion or resting platform with its posts, railings, woven roof or mat texture, and the reclining scholar inside. Include the bench/platform and the visible architectural frame, but exclude the large tree, fields, and neighboring grasses as separate motifs.
must_preserve: straight ruled roof and railing geometry
vertical posts and horizontal platform lines
woven crosshatch texture on the top surface
small reclining scholar figure with head, robe outline, and relaxed pose
thin ink outlines and light interior wash

motifs.name: terraced_field_bands
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal cultivated field or garden rows behind the pavilion and tree. Include the repeated parallel bands and short vertical hatch marks suggesting planted ridges, while excluding the tree trunk, pavilion architecture, and seals.
must_preserve: layered horizontal wash bands
regular short hatch strokes forming crop rows
soft fading edges where the field recedes
subtle grey-brown ink texture

motifs.name: right_marsh_reed_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-right marsh bank with dense upright reeds and grasses around the water edge. Include the fine reed stems, feathery tips, and small shoreline stones, avoiding nearby red seals and unrelated lotus clusters below.
must_preserve: thin vertical reed linework
overlapping grass tufts of varied height
soft ink wash at the waterline
small scattered stones near the reed base
delicate pale outlines at the reed tips

motifs.name: upper_right_lotus_pool
motifs.description: Isolate the small pool area below the right reed bank with scattered lotus leaves, rounded rocks, and faint water wash. Keep this as a compact water-and-lotus surface, excluding adjacent seals and the larger lower stream.
must_preserve: rounded lotus leaves in pale and dark wash
irregular shoreline stones
thin stems descending into the water
soft horizontal water-wash marks
contrast between dark ink stones and light floating leaves

motifs.name: central_winding_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the winding stream and earthen banks crossing the lower middle of the composition. Include the curving grey wash, dark bank contours, small rocks, and open water spaces, but exclude the pavilion, main tree, and bottom lotus cluster.
must_preserve: sinuous bank contour lines
layered grey ink water washes
small rounded rocks along the bends
dry-brush texture on the banks
misty soft edges where water fades into paper

motifs.name: lower_lotus_rock_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right cluster of lotus leaves and small rocks in the foreground water. Include the dense arrangement of dark and light leaf shapes, pebble forms, and fine stems, while avoiding the red seals at the far right edge.
must_preserve: irregular dark ink lotus leaves
pale rounded leaves with thin outlines
scattered pebble and rock shapes
fine vertical lotus stems
varied ink density from light wash to dark accents

motifs.name: lower_left_reed_clump
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground clump of reeds and grasses at the lower left. Include the arcing blades, dense overlapping stems, and nearby soft ground wash, excluding border marks, seals, and the central stream.
must_preserve: long curved grass blades
dense layered reed strokes
dark-to-light ink variation in individual stems
soft ground wash around the roots
fine dry-brush tips

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
